notes.title: 1.0.1 Update - Difficulty Adjustment
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

- Modified the overall level design.
- Added more safe zones.
- Reduced unpredictable long falls.

We have lowered the difficulty slightly so that more players can take on the challenge.
In the future, hard mode like the previous difficulty may be added separately.

notes.title: 2022.09.15 Patch - Improved the late stage
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Improved the late stage level design.
[list]
[*] Added more safe zones.
[*] After clearing the elevator stage, it is difficult to fall back to the previous stage.
[*] No longer collides with falling objects while falling.
[/list]
